title: Alternative immunity
abstract: A little-known arm of the immune system respond to lipids, with a protein called CD1 driving reactions to bee stings, bacteria, and possibly poison ivy
abstract_zh: 免疫系统中一条鲜为人知的分支对脂质作出反应，蛋白质 CD1 通过驱动对蜜蜂蜇伤、细菌以及可能的毒葛的反应来发挥作用。
